verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a German legal and company-formation platform covering notarization, incorporation, apostilles, translations and tax registration, so fundraising instruments are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence never mentions SAFE or convertible-note templates or generating fundraising documents on standard terms. Notarizing uploaded documents and managing signers are adjacent features that require the founder to supply the document, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate and sign SAFEs or convertible notes on standard terms without drafting from scratch
